{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined wool-blend blazer in a structured lapel cut, knee-length, charcoal grey with hex code #36454F, heavy woven fabric.
A crisp cotton-poplin button-down shirt in a classic collar style, hip-length hem, oatmeal beige with hex code #EFEBE9, smooth poplin weave.
Straight-leg dark denim trousers with a mid-rise waist and clean front pockets, ankle length, deep indigo blue with hex code #1C2B48, sturdy cotton twill.
Minimalist leather ballet flats in a round toe shape, ankle-high shaft coverage not required, soft brown with hex code #5D4037, genuine calfskin leather.
Small silver hoop earrings with polished metal finish, simple circular cut, white rhodium color with hex code #E6E6FA, sterling silver metal.

This outfit balances professional polish with understated comfort, perfectly matching her request for a restrained workday look without anything bright or flashy. The dark denim and structured blazer provide a neat casual aesthetic that fits the everyday formality level while maintaining office-appropriate standards. Soft neutral tones like oatmeal and charcoal ensure the ensemble feels grounded and serious yet approachable for a long day at the desk."}
